set.body: Goal: add automatic guide derivation from trained scale descriptors so callers do not have to manually specify routine axes and legends. Acceptance: GuidePolicy or equivalent derives x/y axes and color/fill legends from TrainedScale/ScaleDescriptor; explicit GuideSpec remains available as an override; scale-trained breaks/labels are used, including transform-aware breaks (log10 axis ticks come from the scale's transform, not Breaks.default over the layout interval); the compiler derives panel x/y data ranges from bound position scales, or trains them from resolved rows when position is unscaled, so callers no longer hand-duplicate data ranges into PanelLayout (DesignGraphics.eventScene currently re-trains Interval ranges the scales already know); tests cover auto axes, auto discrete legend, derived panel ranges, and explicit override behavior on JVM and JS.
